summary: Five more children died within 24 hours, bringing the total death toll to 810 across Bangladesh, according to the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS).

caption:
810 children have died since March in a devastating measles outbreak across Bangladesh.

Five children died in 24 hours between Thursday 8 AM and Friday 8 AM due to measles symptoms, according to the latest report from the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS).

Since March 15, a total of 810 children have died nationwide from measles and measles-like symptoms.

Of the total deaths, 95 children have been confirmed cases of measles, while 715 died with measles symptoms.

In the last 24 hours, 1,137 people were infected with measles or measles-like symptoms.

Since March 15, 15,194 people have been confirmed as measles cases, while 122,150 people have sought medical help for measles-like symptoms.

Out of those who sought help, 104,717 people were admitted to hospitals, and 101,560 have since recovered and returned home.

#Bangladesh #HealthCrisis #MeaslesOutbreak #PublicHealth #DGHS

Source: Dhaka Tribune, Jamuna TV, Prothom Alo, The Daily Star

headline_marked: [[Bangladesh secure direct quarterfinal berth]] at 2026 Asian Games cricket
headline: Bangladesh secure direct quarterfinal berth at 2026 Asian Games cricket
summary: The men's team earns automatic knockout stage entry based on ICC T20I rankings for the event in Nagoya, Japan.
details: Bangladesh have secured a direct place in the knockout stage of the men's cricket event at the 2026 Asian Games, to be held in Nagoya, Japan, in September.
The draw for the competitions was conducted on Thursday, with Bangladesh, India, Pakistan, and Sri Lanka earning automatic quarterfinal berths based on the ICC men's T20I rankings.
The men's event will feature 10 teams, with six teams competing in the first round for the remaining four quarterfinal places.
Afghanistan, Japan, and Nepal are in Group A, while Hong Kong, Malaysia, and Oman will contest Group B. The top two teams from each group will advance to the quarterfinals.
In the women's competition, eight teams will compete, starting directly from the quarterfinal stage.
Bangladesh women will face China, while India takes on Japan, Sri Lanka meets Malaysia, and Pakistan plays Thailand. The women's event is scheduled for September 17-22.
caption:
Direct to the knockouts! Bangladesh men's cricket team secures a direct quarterfinal spot for the 2026 Asian Games.

Bangladesh have secured a direct place in the knockout stage of the men's cricket event at the 2026 Asian Games, to be held in Nagoya, Japan, in September.

The draw for the competitions was conducted on Thursday, with Bangladesh, India, Pakistan, and Sri Lanka earning automatic quarterfinal berths based on the ICC men's T20I rankings.

The men's event will feature 10 teams, with six teams competing in the first round for the remaining four quarterfinal places.

Afghanistan, Japan, and Nepal are in Group A, while Hong Kong, Malaysia, and Oman will contest Group B. The top two teams from each group will advance to the quarterfinals.

In the women's competition, eight teams will compete, starting directly from the quarterfinal stage.

Bangladesh women will face China, while India takes on Japan, Sri Lanka meets Malaysia, and Pakistan plays Thailand. The women's event is scheduled for September 17-22.

Source: The Daily Star, Prothom Alo
